title: Release calendar pilot
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: For now the production release window is Friday afternoon, 14:00 to 16:00 Singapore time.
Support has the lowest ticket volume then. Mei will keep an eye on the first two releases; please put the rollback SHA in the ticket.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Depot shadowing notebook
author: Yuki Mori
text: A supervisor uses two browser windows because the arrivals screen loses scroll position. She calls both windows the board. The word dashboard did not come up once in the interview.

title: Webhook retry budget
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Retry carrier webhooks for at most 24 hours, then move them to the dead-letter queue.
A week of retries hides broken partner credentials. Chen owns the replay runbook; do not throw away the original event timestamp.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Sakura residency review
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Keep Sakura customer payloads and their backups in Japan.
The procurement addendum includes backups, not just the primary store. Singapore can receive aggregate counters without shipment identifiers.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Monsoon ETA timeout
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: After 800 milliseconds without a route-model response, return the last carrier ETA with its observed_at timestamp.
A slightly old estimate beats holding the dispatch screen open. Yuki asked that we show the age instead of pretending this is a fresh prediction.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Analytics office hours
author: Tomoko Ito
text: The export total and the tile total differ because the tile excludes cancelled shipments. Nur found the same two cancellations in the ledger. No missing rows so far; the query links are in the notebook.

title: Metering working session
author: Nur Aziz
text:
Nur Aziz: Bill once per completed shipment, not per tracking event.
Scans are noisy and some carriers send ten times as many. Finance will reconcile against the completed ledger, with cancellations excluded.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Demo tenant cleanup
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Use fabricated shipments in shared sandboxes; customer payloads cannot be copied there.
Even a masked address can be reconstructed from the route and phone suffix. Daniel has a generator for the Osaka demo.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: QA pairing notes: barcodes
author: Kavya Iyer
text: The scanner reads the new glossy labels when tilted. A matte label passes at every angle. The test video includes the desk lamp position, since the first clip made this look random.

title: Tracking pagination edge cases
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Order tracking cursors by ingestion sequence, not carrier event time.
Late offline scans otherwise land behind a cursor the client has already passed. Event time remains the time shown in the timeline.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: APAC rota handoff
author: Mei Tan
text:
Mei Tan: Every production change needs a primary and a secondary responder online for the next two hours.
The secondary cannot also be the person driving a customer workshop. Haruto will maintain the rota in Singapore time.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Restore drill follow-up
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Run a restore drill every quarter using an isolated tenant fixture.
A green backup job is not proof of a usable restore. The April drill only restored metadata; next time include the event index.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Demo rehearsal: Osaka
author: Daniel Lim
text: The cross-dock animation runs too fast for the interpreter. We paused on the lane map and everyone could follow it. The customer wants to see the late-truck story before the admin setup.

title: Break-glass review
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Support production access expires after 60 minutes and requires a ticket reference.
Ravi's late shift surfaced the abandoned sessions. No standing access for the night queue; security can approve another timed grant.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Kestrel connector capacity
author: Chen Wei
text:
Chen Wei: Limit each Kestrel tenant to four concurrent polling requests.
Their signed API agreement allows four slots per tenant. The current 429 graph is global, so Linh is splitting it before tuning anything.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Route Lens naming discussion
author: Aisha Rahman
text: Three interviewees heard root lens rather than route lens. The mock-up with the road icon helped. Farah has the audio clips for anyone writing the launch narration.

title: Route Lens price card
author: Nur Aziz
text:
Nur Aziz: Route Lens will cost USD 99 per workspace per month at general availability.
The price assumes one regional model pass per shipment. We are not sending annual contracts yet; Arjun can use the number in pilot estimates.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Queue log sampling
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Log event IDs and error codes only; do not log carrier payload bodies.
Our parser exceptions currently stringify the body. Pranav will replace that before the next connector goes live.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Replay safety checklist
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: A replay of more than 10000 events needs approval from the incident commander.
Small replays use the normal support ticket. The threshold is event count, not parcel count; one parcel can have many scans.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Platform retro: useful screenshots
author: Mei Tan
text: The most useful support screenshot this month included the tenant selector and the browser clock. The most confusing one cropped both. Ravi has a redacted example in the retro folder.

title: Invoice currency close
author: Nur Aziz
text:
Nur Aziz: Lock invoice exchange rates at the start of the billing month.
Use the treasury snapshot for that month. Recomputing at invoice download time gave Meridian two different totals for the same invoice.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Tenant deletion review
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Delete shipment payloads within 30 days of a verified tenant deletion request.
Audit records are separate and keep their 365-day retention. Thao will draw that distinction in the support article.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Booking API retry contract
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Keep booking idempotency tokens for 72 hours and scope them to the tenant.
The mobile client can reconnect after a weekend. A token reused by another tenant must not reveal the first tenant's booking.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Mobile upload interview
author: Yuki Mori
text: The grey badge looks disabled to two drivers. They both tapped it repeatedly while offline. We have interview clips and a paper sketch of a pending state; no implementation review yet.

title: Manifest schema rollout
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Keep readers compatible with the previous manifest schema for 30 days after a writer upgrade.
Kestrel warehouses update on their own calendar. A clean server deploy does not mean every scanner has refreshed its client.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Customer incident comms
author: Siti Nuraini
text:
Siti Nuraini: For a severity-one incident, send the first customer notice within 30 minutes of confirmation.
It is fine to say the cause is unknown. Waiting for a polished root cause left Sakura hearing about their outage from a driver.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: INC-042 review: the Friday release
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases.
The 6 March rollout at 15:10 SGT stalled dispatch acknowledgements for 47 minutes. The rollback engineer was on a flight and the secondary was in a customer call. Emergency mitigation requires incident commander approval and two responders. Mei owns this rule; the ordinary release slots move to Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: INC-042 customer impact audit
author: Mei Tan
text: Siti reconciled the affected depot list against the acknowledgement trace. Seven depots saw delayed status, with no lost bookings. The customer-facing timeline now uses SGT consistently instead of mixing local clocks.

title: Webhook budget after partner review
author: Chen Wei
text:
Chen Wei: Reduce the webhook retry horizon from 24 hours to six hours; dead-letter handling stays unchanged.
The carrier only keeps its signature keys valid for eight hours now. Replaying a signed request tomorrow cannot succeed.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Support session review, March
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Production support sessions now expire after 30 minutes instead of 60.
The access proxy supports renewal in place, so nobody needs a standing grant to finish a ticket.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Route Lens commercial reset
author: Nur Aziz
text:
Nur Aziz: Replace the USD 99 workspace fee with USD 149 per workspace per month for new Route Lens subscriptions.
The second inference pass makes the original price uneconomic. Aisha approved the change. Signed pilot order forms retain their quoted price for six months; unsigned proposals get the new card. Arjun needs to refresh the Meridian draft.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Route Lens launch replan
author: Aisha Rahman
text:
Aisha Rahman: Move Route Lens general availability from 15 April to 2 June 2026.
The Jakarta pilot has only one passing week, and the three-week gate stays in force. Preview tenants keep access without a production SLA. Farah owns the website date and Siti owns customer notices.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Enterprise audit addendum
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Extend tenant audit retention from 365 days to 730 days for all tenants.
The new standard addendum removes the shorter tier. Shipment payload deletion remains a separate 30-day process.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Customer training office hours
author: Siti Nuraini
text: A warehouse lead asked whether a grey ETA meant the shipment stopped moving. It meant the browser was offline. Budi has the reproduction video and the browser network log.

title: Kestrel v3 contract accepted
author: Chen Wei
text:
Chen Wei: Reduce Kestrel polling concurrency to two requests per tenant, replacing the four-slot limit.
The partner exchanges concurrency for a larger page size. Keep the cursor persistence behavior unchanged.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Rural booking retry follow-up
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Extend booking idempotency retention from 72 hours to seven days.
The rural pilot has drivers offline for four days. Tenant scoping remains mandatory; the store estimate includes the additional tokens.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: ETA timeout tuning
author: Mei Tan
text:
Mei Tan: Lower the route-model timeout from 800 to 600 milliseconds, preserving the timestamped carrier fallback.
Kavya measured UI abandonment at the old tail. This changes the wait budget, not the freshness wording.
Attendees checked the migration ticket. The old handbook link is still circulating in onboarding.

title: Platform handover inbox
author: Mei Tan
text: The first handover inbox has questions about old cursor choices and current rota coverage. Chen found the relevant notebook links. Mei is collecting unanswered questions for Friday's team discussion, not a production release.

title: September onboarding interviews
author: Aisha Rahman
text: Two new customer admins found the integration checklist through search rather than the sidebar. Both searched for carrier setup. Thao has the session timestamps for the information architecture review.

title: Warehouse glossary test
author: Yuki Mori
text: The carton icon reads as a package to the Singapore group and as an archive box to the Tokyo group. The text label removes the ambiguity. The notes include both language versions for reference.
